answer: To resist Sybils, every agent ties its identity to a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Valid actions weave an unforgeable thread of verified work into an identity ledger. Minting new nodes demands a stake that scales superlinearly; malicious swarms face exponential capital exhaustion, freezing rogue clones like a glacier. Authentic nodes preserve trust, turning the validated network into a safe oasis.
